title: First successful V-2 rocket launch at Peenemunde
summary: A German A-4 rocket, later called the V-2, flew about 190 kilometres from Peenemunde and reached the edge of space.
reason: The German army had funded Wernher von Braun's rocket programme as a long-range weapon not limited by the Versailles Treaty.
significance: It was the first human-made object to reach space, and its technology later fed both Soviet and American space programmes.
